title: AI / 工具使用
description: 使用AI工具與數位工具的表達

sentences.en: The AI chatbot that I have been using to practice foreign languages provides instant feedback and corrects my grammar mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我一直用來練習外語的AI聊天機器人提供即時回饋並糾正我的文法錯誤。

sentences.en: After training the machine learning model on thousands of labeled images, it achieved an accuracy rate exceeding ninety-five percent.
sentences.zh: 在用數千張標記圖片訓練機器學習模型後，它達到了超過百分之九十五的準確率。

sentences.en: The text generated by the AI assistant, which I used as a starting point, required significant editing to match my writing style.
sentences.zh: AI助理生成的文字——我拿來作為起點——需要大量編輯才能符合我的寫作風格。

sentences.en: To get better results from an AI tool, you need to write clear and specific prompts that describe exactly what you want.
sentences.zh: 要從AI工具獲得更好的結果，你需要撰寫清晰且具體的提示，準確描述你想要的內容。

sentences.en: The image generation tool, powered by a neural network trained on millions of artworks, can create stunning visuals from text descriptions.
sentences.zh: 由數百萬件藝術品訓練的神經網路驅動的圖片生成工具，可以從文字描述建立令人驚豔的視覺效果。

sentences.en: Although AI translation tools have improved dramatically in recent years, they still struggle with idiomatic expressions and cultural nuances.
sentences.zh: 雖然AI翻譯工具近年來有了巨大的進步，它們仍然難以處理慣用語和文化差異。

sentences.en: The automated scheduling assistant, which integrates with my calendar and email, arranges meetings without any manual input from me.
sentences.zh: 與我的行事曆和電子郵件整合的自動排程助理，不需要我任何手動操作就能安排會議。

sentences.en: Using AI-powered code completion tools has reduced the time I spend writing boilerplate code by approximately forty percent.
sentences.zh: 使用AI驅動的程式碼自動完成工具，將我花在撰寫樣板程式碼的時間減少了大約百分之四十。

sentences.en: The speech recognition system, which converts spoken words into text in real time, has made transcribing interviews much easier.
sentences.zh: 即時將口語轉換為文字的語音辨識系統，讓轉錄訪談變得容易多了。

sentences.en: Before relying on AI-generated content for important documents, always verify the facts because these tools can produce inaccurate information.
sentences.zh: 在依賴AI生成的內容用於重要文件之前，務必驗證事實，因為這些工具可能產生不準確的資訊。

sentences.en: The recommendation algorithm that suggests products based on my browsing history has become eerily accurate at predicting my preferences.
sentences.zh: 根據我瀏覽歷史推薦產品的推薦演算法，在預測我的偏好方面已經變得不可思議地準確。

sentences.en: Integrating an AI assistant into our customer service workflow has reduced average response times from hours to mere seconds.
sentences.zh: 將AI助理整合到我們的客服工作流程中，已將平均回應時間從數小時縮短到僅僅幾秒。

sentences.en: The natural language processing model, which was fine-tuned on domain-specific data, understands technical terminology far better than generic models.
sentences.zh: 在領域專用資料上微調過的自然語言處理模型，比通用模型更能理解技術術語。

sentences.en: Learning to write effective prompts for AI tools, a skill that is increasingly valued in the workplace, requires practice and experimentation.
sentences.zh: 學會為AI工具撰寫有效的提示——一項在職場上越來越受重視的技能——需要練習和實驗。

sentences.en: The AI-powered grammar checker that I installed as a browser extension catches errors that I would normally overlook while typing quickly.
sentences.zh: 我作為瀏覽器擴充功能安裝的AI文法檢查器，能抓到我快速打字時通常會忽略的錯誤。

sentences.en: Automating repetitive data entry tasks using robotic process automation tools has freed up valuable time for more creative work.
sentences.zh: 使用機器人流程自動化工具自動化重複性的資料輸入任務，釋放了寶貴的時間用於更具創意的工作。

sentences.en: The deepfake detection tool, developed by researchers at a major university, can identify manipulated videos with remarkable precision.
sentences.zh: 由一所大型大學的研究人員開發的深偽偵測工具，能以驚人的精確度識別被操縱的影片。

sentences.en: Although the AI summarization tool condensed the fifty-page report into two paragraphs, it missed several key points that were essential.
sentences.zh: 雖然AI摘要工具將五十頁的報告濃縮成兩段，但它遺漏了幾個重要的關鍵點。

sentences.en: The voice cloning technology, which can replicate someone's voice from just a few seconds of audio, raises serious ethical concerns.
sentences.zh: 僅從幾秒鐘的音頻就能複製某人聲音的語音複製技術，引發了嚴重的倫理疑慮。

sentences.en: Setting up automation workflows that connect different apps and trigger actions based on specific conditions has simplified my daily routine.
sentences.zh: 設定連接不同應用程式並根據特定條件觸發動作的自動化工作流程，簡化了我的日常事務。

sentences.en: The AI model that generates meeting summaries automatically saves our team at least two hours of manual note-taking every week.
sentences.zh: 自動生成會議摘要的AI模型每週為我們團隊節省至少兩小時的手動記錄時間。

sentences.en: Training a custom AI model on your company's internal documents can create a powerful knowledge base that answers employee questions instantly.
sentences.zh: 用公司的內部文件訓練自訂AI模型，可以建立一個即時回答員工問題的強大知識庫。

sentences.en: The optical character recognition software, which converts scanned documents into editable text, occasionally misreads characters in low-quality images.
sentences.zh: 將掃描文件轉換為可編輯文字的光學字元辨識軟體，偶爾會在低品質圖片中誤讀字元。

sentences.en: Using AI tools responsibly means understanding their limitations, verifying their outputs, and being transparent about their use in your work.
sentences.zh: 負責任地使用AI工具意味著了解它們的局限性、驗證它們的輸出，並對你工作中的使用保持透明。

sentences.en: The predictive text feature on my phone, which learns from my typing patterns, now suggests complete sentences that match my communication style.
sentences.zh: 我手機上從我打字模式學習的預測文字功能，現在能建議符合我溝通風格的完整句子。

sentences.en: Deploying a chatbot on our company website, which handles frequently asked questions automatically, has reduced the workload on our support team.
sentences.zh: 在我們公司網站部署自動處理常見問題的聊天機器人，減輕了我們支援團隊的工作負擔。

sentences.en: The data visualization tool that uses AI to suggest the most appropriate chart type makes presenting complex information much more intuitive.
sentences.zh: 使用AI建議最適當圖表類型的資料視覺化工具，讓呈現複雜資訊變得更加直覺。

sentences.en: Before submitting the AI-generated essay to my professor, I spent considerable time fact-checking every claim and rewriting unclear passages.
sentences.zh: 在將AI生成的文章提交給教授之前，我花了相當多時間查核每個主張並改寫不清楚的段落。

sentences.en: The sentiment analysis tool that processes thousands of customer reviews daily helps our marketing team understand public opinion about our products.
sentences.zh: 每天處理數千則客戶評論的情感分析工具，幫助我們的行銷團隊了解公眾對我們產品的看法。

sentences.en: Combining multiple AI tools into a single automated pipeline, where each tool handles a different stage, produces results far superior to any individual tool.
sentences.zh: 將多個AI工具組合成單一自動化流程——每個工具處理不同階段——產生的結果遠優於任何單一工具。
